title: Questions 161-164 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Traffic Notice

The city council wishes to inform residents and business owners that the 12th Annual Riverside Marathon will be held on Saturday, 8 June. To keep the roughly 3,000 runners safe, Quay Road will be closed to vehicles from 7:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. – [1] –.

Traffic congestion is expected to continue throughout the day. – [2] –. Drivers are therefore advised to take the Eastern Link to detour the city centre. Electronic signs will be set up at the main intersections to guide drivers to alternative routes.

Please be aware that any vehicle left on Quay Road after 5:00 A.M. on that day will be towed away, and the owner will be responsible for the cost. – [3] –. We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for cooperating in making this community occasion a success. – [4] –.
